question: Should `photoscrawl classify` allow arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoint URLs for image classification, and should the new asset export command land in the same PR?
rationale: The repository policy requires opt-in model calls to identify what assets or derived media leave the machine, and the added export surface touches the Photos no-mutation boundary.

options.title: Require guards and disclosure
options.body: Keep the LM Studio path, but require loopback enforcement or accurate cloud-transmission evidence/docs, plus an export destination guard, before merge.

options.title: Accept arbitrary endpoints
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally allow remote-compatible endpoints, but should own the privacy wording and evidence semantics before merge.

options.title: Split export scope
options.body: Ask for a narrower classifier PR and review the new export command separately as its own media retrieval surface.

recommendation.title: Require guards and disclosure
recommendation.body: Keep the LM Studio path, but require loopback enforcement or accurate cloud-transmission evidence/docs, plus an export destination guard, before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: joshp123 introduced the local multimodal classifier and evidence boundary being extended here.
